visual_action: A slideshow of still photos of Donald Trump. The images include a close-up of his face with a heavy tan and eyes closed; him swinging a golf club; a close-up on his hands showing a large dark mark or bruise on one; him eating a piece of meat under a red tent; and him sitting barefoot on a large, white, swan-shaped sculpture or piece of furniture.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: The entire video is a montage of still photographs of Donald Trump.

on_screen_text.text: and I got some pretty feet

spoken_summary: The audio is a song with a female vocalist singing lyrics about being physically attractive. The lines used in the clip are: "My face a 10, my body tea... Everything on me natural, I'm petite. And I got some pretty feet."
audio_music: The video is set to the hip-hop track "Life Is Easy" by DEMIYAA, Lil Rae. The song's lyrics about being beautiful and natural are used sarcastically to create a mocking effect when paired with unflattering images of Donald Trump.
editing_pacing: The video is a slow-paced slideshow of still images, with each photo or a zoom-in on a photo timed to a specific line of the song's lyrics.
cultural_references: The song 'Life Is Easy' by DEMIYAA, Lil Rae is used as the audio track.
central_claim: The video uses sarcastic lyrics about physical perfection to mock Donald Trump's appearance.
intended_effect: To encourage viewers to laugh at and ridicule Donald Trump by juxtaposing flattering lyrics with unflattering photos of him.
